resources.string: Add a provider by hand, or paste a block of text to import keys, endpoints, models and balance settings at once.
A probe tells you which key is dead, which model is missing, and which account is out of credit.
What is encrypted, and what is not

API keys, platform account passwords, balance access tokens and WebDAV credentials are encrypted per field with AES-256-GCM. Everything else — provider names, notes, endpoints, model lists, balance amounts, timestamps — is stored as plain text in the app private directory. The wording is deliberately precise: this is not whole-database encryption.
Platform accounts are a local record: no autofill, no TOTP, no leak checks
